definitions.explanation: Any physical material or device used to store data or information.

examples.japanese: USBメモリは{便利|べんり}な{記録媒体|きろくばいたい}だ。
examples.english: USB drives are convenient storage media.

examples.japanese: {記録媒体|きろくばいたい}の{容量|ようりょう}が{足|た}りない。
examples.english: The storage medium doesn't have enough capacity.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}い{記録媒体|きろくばいたい}のデータを{新|あたら}しいものに{移|うつ}した。
examples.english: I transferred the data from old storage media to new ones.

notes:
{記録媒体|きろくばいたい} is a technical term for any device or material that stores data. It encompasses both digital and analog storage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記録媒体|きろくばいたい}に{保存|ほぞん}する (to save to storage medium)
- {記録媒体|きろくばいたい}の{種類|しゅるい} (types of storage media)
- {外部|がいぶ}{記録媒体|きろくばいたい} (external storage medium)

EXAMPLES OF {記録媒体|きろくばいたい}:
- ハードディスク (hard disk)
- SSD (solid state drive)
- USBメモリ (USB flash drive)
- SDカード (SD card)
- CD/DVD/ブルーレイ (CD/DVD/Blu-ray)
